_keys.band: [lo, hi] level range of the pack
_keys.hubs: h = index+1 used by quest entities. n quests, svc = inn/fm/zep/stable nearby
_keys.part: sub-region letter if the band was cut for size, with the zones in `zones`
_keys.quests.ex: exclusiveTo: quests that lock this one out
_keys.quests.f: finisher entity, same shape as s; the string 's' means same entity as the starter
_keys.quests.fl: flags: elite group escort dungeon profession rep breadcrumb chainHead class:<TOKEN>
_keys.quests.l: questLevel (requiredLevel/1 if the DB says scaling)
_keys.quests.o: objectives: k c creature | o object | i item | t explore trigger, x=1 from extraObjectives; i id, n name, t text, lv [minLevel, maxLevel], rk rank (0 normal 1 elite 2 rare-elite 3 boss 4 rare; for items = easiest source), c up to 2 clusters {z zone, x, y, r radius, n spawns}, sp total spawns, src top drop sources [npc, name], ns total drop sources if more were considered
_keys.quests.of: objective-first hint from Forever: item | killCredit
_keys.quests.pa: preQuestGroup: all of these must be turned in first
_keys.quests.r: races the quest is limited to (absent = all faction races)
_keys.quests.rw: reward items: i, n, c item class, s subClass, il itemLevel, rl requiredLevel, up=1 upgradeCandidate (weapon/armor above the level baseline), bag=1 container
_keys.quests.s: starter entity {k: n|o|i npc/object/item, i, n, z, x, y, h hub}
_keys.quests.sa: up to 2 alternative starters as [k, i, n, z, x, y]
_keys.quests.xp: XP reward at questLevel (xpDB-classic), absent if unknown
_keys.quests.z: primary zone id (starter zone, else finisher, else zoneOrSort)
_keys.xpBudget: XP needed to climb lo -> hi (Classic table); aim for 110-130% in the route
_keys.zones: i = zone id, n = name, q = quests starting there, lv = [min, max] quest level

quests.t: Sir S. J. Erlgadin of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill 10 Shadowmaw Panthers.
Sir S. J. Erlgadin of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to bring him the Fang of Bhag'thera.
Hemet Nesingwary wants you to kill 10 Jungle Stalkers.
Hemet Nesingwary wants you to kill Tethis, an elusive, dangerous raptor in Stranglethorn.
Hemet Nesingwary wants you to bring him the head of King Bangalash, the great white tiger.
Acquire 18 Skullsplitter Tusks and return them to Kebok.
Take the purchase order to Alessandro Luca in the Undercity.
Bring the Field Sampling Kit to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.
Speak to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan about getting a power source for the testing kit.

quests.t: Bring pages 1, 4, 6, and 8 of Nesingwary's The Green Hills of Stranglethorn to Barnil Stonepot in order to complete Chapter I.

rw.n: Green Hills of Stranglethorn - Chapter II

quests.t: Bring pages 10, 11, 14 and 16 of Nesingwary's The Green Hills of Stranglethorn to Barnil Stonepot in order to complete Chapter II.

rw.n: Green Hills of Stranglethorn - Chapter III

quests.t: Bring pages 18, 20, 21and 24 of Nesingwary's The Green Hills of Stranglethorn to Barnil Stonepot in order to complete Chapter III.

rw.n: Green Hills of Stranglethorn - Chapter IV

quests.t: Bring pages 25, 26, and 27 of Nesingwary's The Green Hills of Stranglethorn to Barnil Stonepot in order to complete Chapter IV.
Seek out Witch Doctor Unbagwa and have him summon Mokk the Savage. Bring the Heart of Mokk to Fin Fizracket.
Report to Melisara at Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills.
Kill Lord Aliden Perenolde and ask his mistress, Elysa, about Taretha's pendant.
Return Taretha's pendant to Krusk in Tarren Mill.
Kill 10 Crushridge Maulers for Melisara in Tarren Mill.
Kill Targ, Muckrake, and Glommus and bring their heads to Melisara in Tarren Mill.
Kill Mug'Thol, and return his head with the Crown of Will to Melisara in Tarren Mill.
Deliver the Crown of Will to Sharlindra in the Undercity.
Kill Baron Vardus and deliver his head to High Executor Darthalia in Tarren Mill.

Bring an Aged Gorilla Sinew to Far Seer Mok'thardin in Grom'gol.
Bring 10 Jungle Stalker Feathers to Far Seer Mok'thardin at the Grom'gol base camp.

Dizzy One-Eye in Booty Bay wants you to retrieve his eye from the Bloodsail Buccaneers.
Bring Gan'zulah's Head and Nezzliok's Head to the bubbling cauldron at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
Bring a Balia'mah Trophy, a Ziata'jai Trophy and a Zul'Mamwe Trophy to the Bubbling Cauldron at the Grom'gol Base Camp.

Deeg in Booty Bay wants you to bring him 15 shares of Snuff.
Speak with Kin'weelay.
Bring 3 Pulsing Blue Shards to Kin'weelay at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
Bring the Mind's Eye to Kin'weelay at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
Bring the Filled Soul Gem to Nimboya.
First Mate Crazz wants you to check the cove north of Booty Bay.
Report your findings to First Mate Crazz in Booty Bay.
Bring 25 Split Bone Necklaces to Kin'weelay at the Grom'gol Base camp.
Report the planned Bloodsail attack to Fleet Master Seahorn.
Bring 10 Singing Blue Crystals to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay.
Fleet Master Seahorn in Booty Bay wants you to kill 10 Bloodsail Swashbucklers and bring back the Bloodsail Charts and the Bloodsail Orders.
Bring 5 Mistvale Giblets to "Shaky" Phillipe in Booty Bay.
Bring Shaky's Payment to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley.
Fleet-Master Seahorn in Booty Bay wants you to kill Captain Stillwater, Captain Keelhaul and Fleet Master Firallon.

Bring Maury's Key to "Sea Wolf" Mackinley in Booty Bay.
Bring 10 Bundles of Akiris Reed to Privateer Bloads in Booty Bay.
Bring 12 samples of Zanzil's Mixture to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay.
Solve the riddle!
Bring an Elder Crocolisk Skin to Drizzlik in Booty Bay.

Bring the restored Sigil of Thoradin to Zengu in Hammerfall.
Retrieve the Sigil of Arathor and return it to Zengu in Hammerfall.
Kill Prince Galen Trollbane and bring the Sigil of Trollbane to Zengu in Hammerfall.
Retrieve Trol'kalar from Trollbane's tomb in Stromgarde.
Deliver Trol'kalar to Zengu in Hammerfall.
Gather the Burning Key, the Cresting Key and the Thundering Key from the Stone of West Binding, the Stone of East Binding and the Stone of Outer Binding. Bring them to the Stone of Inner Binding.
Find and kill Fozruk. Bring the Rod of Order to the Keystone in the Arathi Highlands.
First Mate Nilzlix wants you to retrieve the Charts and Logs from the Maiden's Folly and the Spirit of Silverpine.
Captain Steelgut in Faldir's Cove wants you to kill 10 Daggerspine Raiders and 3 Daggerspine Sorceresses.
Escort Professor Phizzlethorpe to the cave and back.
Doctor Draxlegauge in Faldir's Cove wants you to collect 10 Elven Gems and return the Goggles of Gem Hunting once you are done.
Protect Shakes O'Breen during the attack.
Take the Elven Gems to Captain O'Breen.
Take the Sample Elven Gem to Fleet Master Seahorn in Booty Bay.
Deliver Seahorn's Letter to Shakes O'Breen in Arathi Highlands.
Retrieve Marez Cowl's Bloodstone Orb and bring it to Tor'gan in Hammerfall.
Kill 10 Boulderfist Brutes and 4 Boulderfist Magi, and return to Drum Fel in the Hammerfall outpost.
Kill 7 Boulderfist Shaman and 3 Boulderfist Lords and return to Drum Fel in the Hammerfall outpost.
Slay Or'Kalar and bring his Head to Korin Fel in the Hammerfall outpost.
Speak with Zaruk in Hammerfall.
Bring the Torn Scroll Fragment, the Crumpled Scroll Fragment and the Singed Scroll Fragment to Theldurin the Lost.

Bring 6 Sawtooth Snapper Claws to Tok'Kar in the Swamp of Sorrows.

Bring 3 Large Stone Slabs to Lotwil Veriatus in the Badlands.
Bring 5 Bracers of Rock Binding to Lotwil Veriatus in the Badlands.
Bring some Patterned Bronze Bracers to Lucien Tosselwrench in the Badlands.

quests.n: Find the Gems and Power Source
quests.t: Recover all three gems and a power source for the necklace from Uldaman, and then bring them to Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath. Jarkal believes a power source might be found on the strongest construct present in Uldaman. From the journal, you…
Deliver the Necklace and Gem Salvage to Dran Droffers in Orgrimmar.
Get Patrick Garrett's family treasure from their family chest in the South Common Hall of Uldaman, and bring it to him in the Undercity.
Escort Rin'ji out of the Quel'Danil Lodge, then find his hidden secret at the Overlook Cliffs to the east.

Save patients by using Triage Bandages to tend to their wounds. You must save 15 patients before 6 of them die from their injuries. Remember the order of triage! Critically Injured Soldiers die the fastest followed by Badly Injured Soldier…
